text.content:
Acheron houses a sprawling @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceOrk000000]{Ork} empire locked in perpetual war between its tribes. The sphere is roughly ten times the size of an ordinary Crystal Sphere and is filled with breathable air rather than vacuum, growing steadily colder toward the core. A dim, sourceless grey twilight lights everything. Its worlds are colossal iron cubes, each dozens of kilometers wide, whose gravity pulls straight down toward whichever face you stand on. Smugglers risk the trip to sell arms that briefly tip the balance between warbands.

Cubes drift and regularly crash together; the impacts barely dent them but pulverize anyone caught in between, so surface cities are eventually flattened and residents prefer tunneled cubes. Those tunnels hold mushroom beds, meltwater from blizzards, and provender stones, ever-growing black blocks of barely edible woody fruit. Farther in, the cubes become pitted stone hulks stuffed with derelict wreckage slowly turning to stone. Few scholars know that time halts on a cube floating free without collisions, so castaways must escape before centuries slip by elsewhere.

@UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceOrk000000]{Orks} dominate Acheron and consider it close to paradise. They fight for the thrill rather than honor, switching warbands from one day to the next, and between battles they can be friendly, even pleasant company. Real leaders are rare, since any Ork with true command ability tends to leave in search of tougher enemies. Broken veterans of other races also drift here, usually seeking a death in battle, and rarely survive long. The sphere has essentially no native wildlife.

Istvarhan, the Moving Fortress, is built from iron and enslaved bodies and lurches across the cubes on its slaves' backs. Its Warboss, Grazdeff the Wise, is a shrewd tactician who welcomes any recruit and wants a ship to lead a WAAAAAGH out of Acheron. Hammergrim is a gloomy @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceSquat0000]{Squat} stronghold founded against the @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceOrk000000]{Orks}, famed for its bladesmiths; its ruler, the Living Ancestor Branka, is newly crowned, and the ghosts of past rulers in the Court of Memory eventually possess and madden every monarch.

The Mines of Marsellin hold countless artifacts and machines, most fused into black iron, and mysteriously restock each day; the rust-scaled dragon Coirosis sells claims and kills claimjumpers. Deeper lies Tintibulus, a silent, asteroid-like band of small volcanic-rock polyhedra good mainly for hiding. Innermost is Ocanthus, a dark void of black ice shards grinding each other into dust. Unreliable tales speak of a sun-sized sea of black ice at the bottom and creatures built of blades.

Story Master only: adventure seeds for this sphere.

The Emperor's Wrath, a legendary warship carrying Syrneth technology, has drifted out of the warp into Acheron, and @UUID[Compendium.dtd40k.races.Item.dtdRaceOrk000000]{Orks} and rival powers from across the Wheel are racing to claim it before it petrifies. Orks may not be born here at all but emerge from tunnels, hinting that the cubes are a Syrneth warrior farm that someone could restart or shut down.

The Living Ancestor of Hammergrim secretly hires the heroes to stop the palace ghosts from driving her mad, though destroying them is taboo and she will betray them if they are caught. Finally, the black ice sea at Acheron's heart is real and imprisons an ancient horror whose stirring scattered the cubes and spawns the shards of Ocanthus.
